content: Simulated designs 1 (reward -1.123) and 2 (reward -0.827). Slew rate (39.4 V/us), gain (632.7), noise (24.3 mV), and area (0.228 um^2) are met. UGBW reached 49 MHz. Key levers: mn1 controls gm1/UGBW/noise; mn4 sets I_tail (60 uA); mn5 sets I_2 (120 uA); balance ratio S_mp3/S_mp1 = 4 maintained; cap=0.5 pF and res=600 ohm. Next priority is fixing phase margin (18.8 deg) and pushing UGBW to 100 MHz.

Best design is id 2 (reward -0.827). Violated specs: phm (18.76 deg, -0.524), ugbw (49.0 MHz, -0.343). Binding spec is phm. Chosen lever: Increase Cc from 0.5 pF and adjust Rc to push zero into LHP, trading some UGBW headroom to establish phase margin > 50-60 deg.

Swept Rc 500->8000 ohm on base 2. PM increased monotonically from 18 deg to 65.8 deg, satisfying phm >= 60 deg at Rc=7000-8000 ohm. Base 13 (Rc=8000) achieves PM=65.8 deg, SR=38.8 V/us, Gain=632, Noise=24.3 mV, UGBW=62.2 MHz (reward -0.211). Only ugbw remains violated.

Best design is id 13 (reward -0.211). Only ugbw (62.2 MHz, -0.233) is violated; phm (65.8 deg), SR (38.8 V/us), gain (633), and noise (24.3 mV) are all satisfied. Chosen lever: Increase input pair gm1 by increasing mn1 from 8 to 14-16 to scale UGBW towards 100 MHz while preserving phase margin and bias current.

Lesson: Swept mn1 10->20 on base 13. UGBW only rose from 62.2 to 64.2 MHz, moving far less than predicted. As circuit-analyst notes, when Cc is small and gm1/Cc approaches the second pole gm6/CL, UGBW saturates. Increasing input pair gm1 alone is ineffective. We need higher gm6 (stage 2) to push the second pole out.

Best design is id 19 (reward -0.196). Binding spec is ugbw (64.2 MHz, -0.218). Gain has large margin (646 vs 200). Chosen lever: Shorten input pair length ln1 from 90 nm to 45 nm to increase gm1 and reduce parasitic capacitance, and adjust Cc towards 0.35-0.4 pF. Expect UGBW to approach 100 MHz while preserving gain > 200.

Lesson: Shortening ln1 to 45 nm caused severe DIBL and output resistance collapse, dropping gain to 98 (target 200) and reducing UGBW to 40.7 MHz. ln1 must remain at 90 nm to maintain stage 1 output resistance. Base 19 remains our best design.

Swept cap [2e-13, 3e-13, 4e-13] on base 19. At cap=2e-13, UGBW reached 81.5 MHz but PM dropped to 41.6 deg; at cap=4e-13 (id 23), reward is -0.194 with UGBW=67.4 MHz and PM=57.4 deg. The non-dominant pole p2 (gm6/CL) limits the phase margin at high UGBW. Handing back to diagnoser.

Best design is id 23 (reward -0.194). Violated: phm (57.4 deg, -0.022), ugbw (67.4 MHz, -0.195). Chosen lever: Scale mp3 to 16 and mp1 to 4 (ratio 4:1) to boost stage 2 gm6 and push non-dominant pole p2 higher, restoring PM > 60 deg while maintaining high UGBW. If this does not reach feasibility, hand over to RL (Phase 3).

Simulated candidate 24 (mp1=4, mp3=16 on base 23). Reward jumped to -0.0643. Slew rate reached 56 V/us, gain 751, UGBW jumped to 84.6 MHz, and PM reached 59.59 deg (within 0.41 deg of target). Excellent progress.

Best design is id 24 (reward -0.0643). Violated specs: phm (59.59 deg, -0.003), ugbw (84.6 MHz, -0.083). At 24 simulator calls (Phase 1 limit 25). Final feasibility attempt: change cap to 3e-13 and res to 9000 ohm on base 24 to scale UGBW > 100 MHz while LHP zero boosts PM > 60 deg. If feasible, enter Phase 2; if not, proceed to Phase 3 (RL refinement).

Candidate 25 simulated (cap=3e-13, res=9000 on base 24): UGBW=93.4 MHz, PM=54.6 deg, SR=61.6 V/us, Gain=751, Reward=-0.0594 (best so far). 25 Phase 1 simulator calls reached. Handing over to Phase 3 (RL refinement) anchored on Candidate 25.

Polish lever: Sweep res across [7500, 7700, 7900, 8100, 8300, 8500] ohm on base 348 to minimize resistor area while holding PM >= 60 deg.

Polish sweep of res [7500..8500] ohm on base 348 complete. Best candidate is 577 (res=7700 ohm): reward improved to 0.6659 (feasible), area reduced to 7.23e-10 m^2 with PM=61.5 deg and UGBW=101.6 MHz.

Candidate 577 remains best overall (FoM 0.6659), with close candidate 595 (FoM 0.6652, wn1=1.25u, res=7800). RL exploration stable around candidate 577. Handing over to phase 4 polish.

Chosen polish lever: Sweep wn1 across [1.0u, 1.25u, 1.5u] on base 577 to reduce area while preserving PM and UGBW.
